title: Unit-normalized underlying set identifications of pro-etale ring and module inverse image
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes and $R$ a sheaf of commutative rings on the small pro-etale site of $Y$ [def-weil-proetale-inverse-image]. Write $L$ for its specified set inverse image, $RI=f^{-1}R$ for its specified ring inverse image, and $I$ for proEtaleModuleInverseImage. There is a unique underlying-set sheaf isomorphism $e_R:L(|R|)\cong |RI|$ which carries the set-adjunction unit of every section $r\in R(V)$ to the ring-adjunction unit of $r$ over $X\times_Y V$. For each $R$-module sheaf $M$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], there is likewise a unique isomorphism $e_M:L(|M|)\cong |I(M)|$ which carries the set-adjunction unit of each section $m\in M(V)$ to the specified module-adjunction unit of $m$ on the transported small model. Both statements use exactly the already specified functors and adjunctions, for every scheme morphism and arbitrary ring sheaf.

proof.text: Lift the finite-limit-preserving set inverse image to ring and module operations, as in the canonical inverse-image construction. The lifted adjunction identifies the underlying ring and module units with the set unit. The specified module functor is the same construction on its equivalent small model, so it has the normalized underlying isomorphism. Two such isomorphisms have equal hom maps: their adjuncts under the set adjunction agree on every original section by the unit formula. Injectivity of the adjunction Hom bijection gives equality, including the inverses. These are the complete existing proofs in words of ringSetsIdentification_exists and moduleSetsIdentification_exists.

theorem ringSetsIdentification_exists {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (R : Rings Y) :
    ∃! e : (AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.setPullback f).obj (ringSets R) ≅
        ringSets (inverseRing f R),
      ∀ (V : Y.ProEt) (r : R.obj.obj (op V)),
        e.hom.hom.app (op ((proEtaleBaseChange f).obj V))
          (((AlgebraicGeometry.ProEtale.setPullbackAdjunction f).unit.app
            (ringSets R)).hom.app (op V) r) =
        ((proEtaleSheafAdjunction f CommRingCat.{u + 1}).unit.app R).hom.app (op V) r
